verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents in-person acceptance on its own stack: a 'Process payments with a device' guide and a Tap to Phone SDK for contactless payments on compatible devices. The evidence does not say these in-person payments settle into the same merchant balances, deposits and reporting as online payins, so unification is only implied by the shared platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that in-person payments share seller balances, deposits and reporting with online payments; details on terminal hardware support; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder with offline sellers, in-person works on the same stack — terminals or tap-to-pay SDKs that settle into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments

citations.quote: Tap to Phone enables merchants to accept contactless payments directly on a compatible device.
